entities.name: Obstructive sleep apnea
observations: OSA was associated with higher colorectal cancer incidence in a 2022 meta-analysis: pooled HR 1.70 (95% CI 1.48–1.96; I²=22%).
A 2022 meta-analysis reported pooled RR 1.75 (95% CI 1.56–1.97) for sleep apnea and combined colorectal neoplasms; this was not adenoma-specific.
A 2023 Taiwanese cohort found a non-significant adjusted HR 1.17 (95% CI 0.82–1.68) for colorectal cancer in the sleep-apnea subgroup.

entities.name: Colorectal cancer
observations: A systematic review/meta-analysis of four adjusted long-follow-up studies found higher incidence associated with OSA: HR 1.70 (95% CI 1.48–1.96; I²=22%).
A nationwide Taiwanese matched cohort found no statistically significant association: adjusted HR 1.17 (95% CI 0.82–1.68).

entities.name: Colorectal neoplasia
observations: A 2022 systematic review/meta-analysis reported pooled RR 1.75 (95% CI 1.56–1.97) for sleep apnea versus comparator, using a combined colorectal-neoplasm endpoint that included colorectal cancer and colorectal adenoma.
The retrieved evidence does not provide a separate pooled adenoma-only effect estimate.
